tasks.subject: Task 1: Symbol-change warning in webhook (Fix 2)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Log a WARNING when the incoming webhook's symbol universe differs from the last successful rebalance.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/rebalance.py` — add `get_last_successful()`
- Modify: `app/webhook.py` — add warning after target_weights parsed
- Modify: `tests/test_rebalance_repository.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_webhook.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `get_last_successful()` returns latest success or None
- [ ] WARNING logged when symbols differ
- [ ] No warning when symbols identical
- [ ] No warning on fresh DB
- [ ] Execution never blocked

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_rebalance_repository.py tests/test_webhook.py -v -k 'last_successful or symbol_universe'`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/rebalance.py", "app/webhook.py", "tests/test_rebalance_repository.py", "tests/test_webhook.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_rebalance_repository.py tests/test_webhook.py -v -k 'last_successful or symbol_universe'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get_last_successful returns latest success or None", "symbol_universe_changed WARNING logged when symbols differ", "no warning when symbols identical", "no warning on fresh DB", "execution never blocked"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Live positions backend (Fix 1 backend)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `GET /positions` to Flask proxying Alpaca live state with 1-hour cache.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/alpaca_client.py`
- Create: `app/positions.py`
- Modify: `app/__init__.py`
- Create: `tests/test_positions.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_alpaca_client.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GET /positions returns correct shape with HTTP 200
- [ ] Cached 1 hour
- [ ] stale:true on Alpaca outage with cache
- [ ] 503 only with no cache and Alpaca down

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_positions.py tests/test_alpaca_client.py -v -k 'positions_full or get_account or test_positions'`

tasks.subject: Task 4: Position drift logging at webhook (Fix 3)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Log WARNING when live Alpaca symbol set diverges from last successful DB event's target_weights.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/webhook.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_webhook.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] position_drift_detected WARNING logged on symbol mismatch
- [ ] No warning in normal operation
- [ ] No warning on fresh DB
- [ ] Single get_last_successful() call per webhook (shared with Task 1)

**Verify:** `pytest tests/test_webhook.py -v -k 'drift'`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/webhook.py", "tests/test_webhook.py"], "verifyCommand": "pytest tests/test_webhook.py -v -k 'drift'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["position_drift_detected WARNING logged on mismatch", "no warning in normal operation", "no warning on fresh DB", "single DB call per request"]}
```
